documents.title: Artificial Intelligence at Duquesne
documents.stance_why: The page sets no university-wide rule on student AI use. It says student AI use 'is governed by individual course syllabi', offers three sample syllabus templates (open, moderate, restrictive) and calls the faculty guidance 'intentionally broad'; so the stance is delegates with tiers.
documents.summary: Provost-office framework page from Duquesne's faculty AI Committee with guidance for faculty on professional development, course policy, assessment and administrative use, plus student guidance. It leaves student rules to course syllabi and supplies three sample statements and a citation template.
